acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a design-build firm for your luxury home in Los Angeles, look for extensive experience with high-end residential projects and a strong portfolio showcasing similar styles and scales. Assess their communication style, ensure they understand your vision, and check client testimonials or references for satisfaction. Verify their licensing, insurance, and professional affiliations. Opus Builders emphasizes transparency, craftsmanship, and a client-focused approach to ensure your project exceeds expectations within the Los Angeles market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a design-build firm based on luxury home experience, portfolio, communication style, client testimonials, and proper licensing, especially for Los Angeles projects.
